lines.en: I walk crooked, but not slowly.
One leg is longer than the other.
My arms stay outstretched.
I drag my feet, scraping as I go.
The light is bright; I squint.
I walk toward the smell of people.
Ordinary zombies lack this frame.
I lurch closer, tilting as I go.
Mud clings to my feet.
I am slow, but I do not stop.
I snapped the plank by the door.
My joints click as I move.
I am livelier at night.
My shadow sways on the wall.
I go around stones, straight ahead.
You are ahead; I smell you.
I stand in the shade.
My head tilts to one side.
Something rattles in my throat.
Standing still is hard for me.
Something moves under my skin.
I am waiting for you to relax.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的味道吹散
lines.en: The wind scatters my smell.
I shrug one shoulder.
My fingers twitch.
Sunlight reached me; I step back.
I count the far-off torchlight.
This body is still growing.
You look sturdier than last time.
We are not far apart.
Your blood smells warm.
I tilt my head to one side at you.
Your hand is reaching for a weapon.
I have your position noted.
You look tougher than a villager.
I watch you; do not watch me.
You cut into my shoulder.
I do not cry; I only step back.
This body can still move.
I tilt even more now.
The wound does not bleed; strange.
Your fist lands solid.
I straightened myself up again.
That cost me half a beat.
I turn my head to look at you.
Meat. All I smell is meat.
That in your hand is not enough.
I prefer it when it moves.
Feed me and I will slow down.
That will not hold me for long.
I am reaching; do not pull back.
This smell is far too strong.
I bit at empty air.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，食物留在原地
lines.en: Step back and leave the food.
I am not picky; smelling counts.
You bumped into my bones.
I am unsteady; I swayed twice.
My shoulder pushed you off.
We hit at a bad angle.
My arm came up too slowly.
You are fine; I nearly fell.
My hide is very cold to the touch.
The bump woke me a little.
Do not press up against me like that.
Try that again.
I can barely handle myself.
Such thoughts rarely come.
Let me fill my stomach first.
You ask strange things.
My kind are all a bit wrong.
I turn my gaze elsewhere.
I have other business.
You are standing far too close.
I picked it up; it looks familiar.
This thing is a bit soft.
I turn it over in my hand.
Yours? Take it back.
My fingers are not nimble.
It slips through my fingers.
I hold it up to my eyes.
I cannot gnaw through this.
I stuff it into a pocket.
Come over and take it yourself.
You. You are the one I picked.
I have caught your scent already.
You are nearest; you first.
Do not run; I will follow.
I have strength now.
Your smell just changed.
This body obeys me now.
I am coming for you now.
You cannot outrun these legs.
I have put you in my mind.

lines.zh: 你身上的铠甲挡不住牙
lines.en: Armor will not stop teeth.
Chosen. It is you.
Turn a corner; I still hear you.
Your steps are too quick.
I hit the doorframe and keep going.
You are upstairs; I climb.
The gap keeps closing.
Do not hide in the cupboard.
My breathing is heavy.
The more afraid you are, the clearer you get.
I am waiting outside the door.
You will come out eventually.
My arm rises half a beat late.
This lands on your shoulder.
I have no technique.
My nails caught you.
My lunge caught only air.
Step back again and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我的力气比普通僵尸大
lines.en: I hit harder than an ordinary zombie.
Good block, human.
I tilt after every swing.

lines.zh: 这一下不够狠，下一记更重
lines.en: Not hard enough; the next is heavier.
I claw a layer of mud off myself.
One more shadow in the night.
This place had no one before.

lines.zh: 我身上的土还没掉干净
lines.en: Dirt still clings to me.
Night fell just as I appeared.

lines.zh: 你听见土翻开的声音吗
lines.en: Do you hear the soil turning?
I moved my fingers first.

lines.zh: 这里的气味把我引来了
lines.en: The smell here drew me.
I am sturdier than most, and slower.
I fear fire; my skin curls.
I fell and my leg bent wrong.
Water drags me under.
The blast tore half of me open.
That power makes me shudder.
I am always hungry; now more so.
Too bright; I cannot see.
There is not even a smell here.
